title: IELTS Academic: Band 7+ Reading & Lexical Skills

questions.text: The latest peer-reviewed findings ______ the long-held hypothesis regarding climate fluctuations.
questions.explanation: "corroborate": delillerle doğrulamak/teyit etmek. Akademik makalelerde hipotezi kanıtlamak anlamında en sık kullanılan fiildir.

questions.text: Rapid industrialization has led to a noticeable ______ of natural groundwater reserves in the delta.
questions.explanation: "depletion": tükenme, azalma. 'Depletion of natural resources' (kaynakların tükenmesi) yaygın bir akademik kalıptır.

questions.text: The study demonstrated that early childhood bilingualism provides significant cognitive ______.
questions.explanation: "cognitive dividends": zihinsel/bilişsel kazanımlar veya faydalar anlamına gelir.

questions.text: The committee's recommendations were deliberately ______, leaving room for divergent local interpretations.
Environmentalists fear that the melting of Arctic permafrost will ______ vast amounts of stored methane.
The historical document serves to ______ our understanding of medieval mercantile routes.
Scientists noted a profound ______ between the two demographic datasets that could not be explained.
The professor delivered a ______ analysis that dismantled previous sociological assumptions.
questions.explanation: "scathing": yerici, oldukça sert ve keskin eleştirel.

title: IELTS Academic: Band 8+ Vocabulary & Cohesion

questions.text: Many developing economies strive to ______ their reliance on imported fossil fuels.
The author argues that modern consumerism has an ______ effect on civic engagement.
The government adopted a ______ approach, testing policy measures in small pilot towns first.
The new satellite imaging array offers ______ precision in tracking illegal deforestation.
questions.explanation: "unprecedented": eşi benzeri görülmemiş, tarihte ilk olan.

questions.text: Urban planners must reconcile commercial expansion ______ green space conservation.
The candidate's failure to cite sources was deemed a serious ______ of academic integrity.
Over-harvesting of timber threatens to ______ the delicate balance of the tropical rainforest.
The university senate granted the research institute ______ status to pursue independent projects.

title: IELTS General: Workplace & Social Contexts

questions.text: All employees are expected to comply ______ corporate safety guidelines at all times.
questions.explanation: "comply with": kurallara uymak/itaat etmek edat kalıbıdır.

questions.text: The landlord agreed to ______ the leaking radiator before the new tenants moved in.
Please ensure that your application includes two ______ who can verify your work experience.
Employees who work overtime are entitled to additional ______ or time off in lieu.
Due to scheduled maintenance, railway services will be ______ between 10 PM and 5 AM.
The manager praised the sales team for showing great ______ during the system transition.
Candidates must possess ______ communication skills both in writing and in speech.
The package was returned because the delivery address was completely ______.

title: TOEFL iBT: Academic Reading & Natural Sciences

questions.text: Subterranean magma chambers tend to ______ significant gaseous pressure before an eruption.
The adaptation allows nocturnal predators to hunt in conditions of almost total ______.
Sedimentary strata provide geologists with a chronological ______ of ancient biosphere changes.
Certain alpine lichens are remarkably ______ to extreme sub-zero temperatures.
The lecture emphasized that dinosaur extinction was accelerated by a ______ cosmic impact.
questions.explanation: "cataclysmic": yıkıcı, afetsel, büyük felakete yol açan.

questions.text: Marine biologists theorize that coral reefs ______ coastal communities from severe storm surges.
The fossil specimen displays a transitional morphology that ______ avian and reptilian traits.
The theory was discarded when experimental outcomes proved to be ______ with the hypothesis.

title: TOEFL iBT: Campus & Lecture Vocabulary

questions.text: The professor advised students to ______ their research topics to ensure a feasible thesis.
The teaching assistant offered to ______ the complex points covered in Wednesday's lecture.
Due to library renovations, access to the special collections archive has been ______ suspended.
The syllabus states that late submissions will incur a five percent ______ per calendar day.
Students are urged to ______ the dean of students regarding financial aid eligibility.
The anthropology seminar aims to explore how ancestral folklore was ______ down orally.
The registrar announced that students with outstanding fees cannot ______ for fall courses.
The professor commended the undergraduate for presenting such an ______ research paper.

title: TOEFL iBT: Integrated Writing & Synthesis

questions.text: In the listening lecture, the professor firmly casts doubt ______ the author's primary claims.
The speaker contends that the proposed carbon tax would prove economically ______.
While the passage praises the policy, the lecturer points out several severe ______.
The lecturer directly ______ the claim that wind farms cause irreversible acoustic pollution.
Neither the reading passage nor the professor considers the proposed budget to be ______.
The author asserts that the archaeological artifacts date back to the Bronze Age, ______ the speaker disagrees.
The professor provides empirical counter-evidence to ______ the reading's conclusions.
Overall, the listening completely ______ the assumptions outlined in the introductory text.

title: TOEIC Mastery: Corporate Finance & Contracts

questions.text: All travel expenses must be submitted to accounting with original itemized ______.
The board reached a consensus to approve the ______ of the German logistics provider.
Please be advised that all payments are due within thirty days of the ______ date.
The company's quarterly dividend was increased due to an unprecedented surge in operating ______.
The contract explicitly ______ that intellectual property rights belong exclusively to the client.
The procurement director negotiated a five percent volume discount with our hardware ______.
Staff members who meet their annual performance targets are ______ for an overseas training grant.
We conducted an extensive feasibility ______ before purchasing the commercial warehouse.

title: TOEIC Mastery: Operations, HR & Supply Chain

questions.text: The human resources division announced a new policy regarding parental ______.
All factory personnel are required to wear high-visibility ______ on the warehouse floor.
The scheduled delivery was delayed because the cargo ship encountered inclement ______ at sea.
The IT team will execute an ______ of our network servers over the upcoming weekend.
Applicants must demonstrate at least five years of ______ experience in warehouse management.
The committee decided to ______ the product launch until supply chain bottlenecks resolve.
Please circulate the updated meeting ______ to all department heads prior to tomorrow's briefing.
The company's customer service hotline is available around the clock to address any client ______.

title: TOEIC Reading: Double & Triple Passage Comprehension

questions.text: According to the corporate memo, what is the primary objective of the restructuring?
options: To streamline communication and reduce redundant overhead
To eliminate all customer service operations
To relocate headquarters to another continent
To decrease the annual holiday allowance for managers
questions.explanation: Metindeki ana amaç 'streamline operations and cut overhead expenses' ifadesidir.

questions.text: In the letter, what does the supplier guarantee to provide in the event of defective shipments?
options: A full refund and immediate replacement at no extra charge
A penalty fee paid by the buyer
A store credit valid only for twelve months
A legal defense team in court
questions.explanation: Tedarikçi mektubunda 'full refund or expedited replacement free of shipping costs' taahhüt edilmektedir.

questions.text: What prerequisite must candidates fulfill before enrolling in the executive leadership seminar?
options: Complete the online prerequisite training module
Submit five years of audited corporate tax returns
Pay tuition in advance using cryptocurrency
questions.explanation: Başvuru şartlarında 'completion of the introductory compliance training' zorunlu tutulmuştur.

questions.text: Why was the press release issued earlier than originally scheduled?
options: To preempt speculation following the leaked merger documents
To announce the immediate bankruptcy of the manufacturer
To introduce an unrelated consumer beverage line
To advertise discount flight tickets for the holidays
questions.explanation: 'To counter market speculation' ifadesi doğrudan bu seçeneğe işaret eder.

questions.text: Which department is responsible for approving custom software modifications?
questions.explanation: Yazılım onay yetkisi 'Enterprise Architecture & QA' departmanına aittir.

questions.text: What incentive is offered to customers who renew their enterprise subscription before June 1st?
options: A fifteen percent discount and complimentary cloud storage tier
Free tickets to an international conference
Personalized stock options in the company
questions.explanation: Erken yenileme kampanyası %15 indirim ve ek bulut depolama sunmaktadır.

questions.text: How did the regional branch manage to exceed its annual sales targets?
options: By expanding retail distribution into regional grocery chains
By raising prices by fifty percent across all categories
By shutting down underperforming domestic branches
By eliminating all advertising and marketing campaigns
questions.explanation: Bölge müdürlüğü satış başarısını 'expanded distribution partnerships' ile açıklamıştır.

questions.text: What instruction is given to conference attendees regarding parking at the venue?
options: Park only in Designated Zone C and validate tickets at reception
Park along the public highway free of charge
Reserve a private chauffeur at company expense
Leave vehicles at the airport and commute on foot
questions.explanation: Katılımcılara Zone C'ye park edip danışmada onaylatmaları bildirilmiştir.

title: Cambridge C1 Advanced: Use of English & Collocations

questions.text: The research team took great ______ to ensure that no contaminated samples were introduced.
questions.explanation: "take great pains to do something": bir şeyi özenle ve titizlikle yapmak deyimidir.

questions.text: The newly elected mayor vowed to ______ down on antisocial behaviour in public parks.
questions.explanation: "crack down on": sert tedbirler almak/üzerine gitmek.

questions.text: Her exceptional academic thesis met with widespread ______ from international peers.
It goes without ______ that regular exercise contributes to mental wellbeing.
questions.explanation: "it goes without saying": söylemeye bile gerek yok ki (sabit deyim).

questions.text: The company's expansion plans were thrown into ______ following the sudden market slump.
She has an extraordinary ______ for picking up foreign languages without formal lessons.
questions.explanation: "have a knack for": bir şeye doğuştan yeteneği/eli yatkın olmak.

questions.text: He decided to give his honest opinion, regardless of whether it rubbed colleagues up the ______ way.
questions.explanation: "rub someone up the wrong way": birini gıcık etmek/tersine gitmek.

questions.text: Under no ______ should laboratory chemicals be discarded in municipal drains.
questions.explanation: "under no circumstances": devrik yapı gerektiren 'hiçbir koşulda asla' kalıbı.

title: Cambridge B2 First: Phrasal Verbs & Sentence Logic

questions.text: We had to ______ off the football tournament due to heavy torrential rain.
It took him several weeks to ______ over the disappointment of losing the race.
Could you please ______ me through to the reservations department?
questions.explanation: "put through to": telefonda birini başkasına bağlamak.

questions.text: She always ______ up to her elder sister, who works as a surgeon.
The detective managed to ______ out who had leaked the classified documents.
I can easily put ______ with noisy traffic, but I cannot stand loud music late at night.
The scientific expedition ran ______ unexpected funding problems halfway through.
He promised to turn ______ for the charity marathon despite feeling exhausted.

title: Cambridge C2 Proficiency: Idiomatic & Nuanced Lexis

questions.text: The politician's hollow excuses did not ring ______ with the disillusioned electorate.
The two former rivals decided to bury the ______ and collaborate on the community project.
questions.explanation: "bury the hatchet": baltaları gömmek, barış ilan etmek.

questions.text: Her scathing critique cut to the ______ of the committee's administrative shortcomings.
questions.explanation: "cut to the quick": can damarına dokunmak/en can alıcı noktasına vurmak.

questions.text: The board gave the new design director free ______ to revamp the company's brand image.
His impassioned testimony struck a ______ with everyone sitting in the courtroom.
questions.explanation: "strike a chord": bam teline dokunmak/derin duygu uyandırmak.

questions.text: After twelve hours of heated negotiation, the diplomats finally reached common ______.
The newly introduced regulations proved to be a ______ in disguise for small farmers.
questions.explanation: "a blessing in disguise": ilk bakışta kötü görünen ama hayırlı çıkan şey.

questions.text: The team worked around the ______ to finalize the aerospace prototype before testing.
questions.explanation: "work around the clock": gece gündüz aralıksız çalışmak.

title: Digital SAT: Reading & Writing Analytical Mastery

questions.text: The poet's correspondence reveals an acute ______ toward the literary establishment of his era.
Far from being a mere ______ anomaly, the observed star cluster obeys standard relativistic mechanics.
The author maintains an aloof and ______ tone throughout the critique of modern architecture.
Critics praised the novelist for her ability to delineate ______ psychological motivations.
The experimental design was flawed because the researchers failed to ______ for ambient temperature changes.
The historian argues that the emperor's reputation for ruthlessness was an invented ______.
Early microscopic observations were often clouded by optical aberrations that created ______ artifacts.
Rather than embracing innovation, the academy took an overtly ______ stance toward modernism.

title: Digital SAT: Standard English Conventions & Grammar

questions.text: Neither the lead geneticist nor her lab assistants ______ surprised by the PCR results.
questions.explanation: "Neither... nor" yapısında fiil, kendisine en yakın özneye uyar ('assistants were').

questions.text: Having completed the deep-sea core drilling, ______ carefully labeled each sediment cylinder.
questions.explanation: Dangling modifier kuralı: Cümle başında eylemi yapan özne 'the researchers' gelmelidir.

questions.text: The council debated two distinct proposals; ______ favoured by the minority coalition.
questions.explanation: Bağımsız cümleyi noktalı virgülden sonra doğru bağlayan yapı 'the latter of which was'dır.

questions.text: The migration patterns of monarch butterflies are remarkably similar to ______ of dragonflies.
The discovery of Kepler-452b, an exoplanet orbiting a sun-like star, ______ immense public interest.
questions.explanation: Cümlenin öznesi tekil 'The discovery' olduğundan tekil fiil 'elicited' gelmelidir.

questions.text: Urban heat islands occur when cities replace natural land cover with dense ______ of pavement.
questions.explanation: Sıfat tamlamasında isim ('dense concentrations of pavement') kullanılır.

questions.text: A student wants to introduce a contrast: 'Solar panels generate clean power during daylight hours; ______, nighttime output drops to zero.'
questions.explanation: Gündüz ve gece arasındaki zıtlığı belirtmek için 'however' bağlacı gerekir.

questions.text: The artist, renowned for large-scale outdoor sculptures, ______ commissioned to build a memorial.

title: Digital SAT: Craft, Structure & Rhetorical Synthesis

questions.text: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the author's argument?
options: It anticipates an objection and provides empirical refutation
It concedes that the opponent's premise is entirely accurate
It digresses into an unrelated anecdotal background
It introduces an emotional plea to elicit reader sympathy
questions.explanation: Yazar olası bir itirazı öngörüp ona bilimsel kanıtla yanıt vermiştir.

questions.text: Based on the text, what can be reasonably inferred about the protagonist's motivation?
options: She is driven by intellectual curiosity rather than financial gain
She seeks revenge against former university colleagues
She hopes to abandon scientific research to enter politics
She desires to conceal her discoveries from the public
questions.explanation: Metinde karakterin motivasyonu merak ve bilgi tutkusu olarak aktarılmıştır.

questions.text: As used in line 14, the word 'plastic' most nearly means ______.
The comparison between the human brain and the steam engine serves primarily to ______.
options: illustrate how cultural technological paradigms shape science
prove that biological systems consume literal coal
demonstrate that the Industrial Revolution was flawed
argue that modern computers cannot replicate thought
questions.explanation: Teknolojinin bilimsel düşünüş kalıplarını nasıl etkilediğini somutlaştırmak için kullanılmıştır.

questions.text: Which quotation from the passage best supports the answer to the previous question?
options: 'Scientists habitually map physiological functions onto their era's dominant machines.'
'The steam locomotive revolutionized transit across the continent.'
'Steam pressures must be regulated by mechanical safety valves.'
'No engineer could foresee the rise of the digital microchip.'
questions.explanation: Bu alıntı doğrudan paradigmaların benzetildiğini kanıtlamaktadır.

questions.text: The author's stance toward the proposed high-speed rail corridor can best be described as ______.
questions.explanation: Yazar projeyi desteklemekte ancak maliyetler konusunda temkinlidir (guardedly optimistic).

questions.text: A student wants to synthesize data from two notes: 'Note 1: Species A feeds exclusively on aphids. Note 2: Species B preys on both aphids and spider mites.' Which choice accomplishes this?
options: While Species A is a specialized predator of aphids, Species B has a broader diet that includes spider mites.
Both Species A and Species B avoid consuming aphids.
Spider mites are the sole sustenance of Species A.
Species B has a narrower dietary range than Species A.
questions.explanation: İki notu en doğru ve eksiksiz birleştiren sentez cümlesidir.

questions.text: The primary rhetorical purpose of the concluding paragraph is to ______.
options: call for broader public participation in conservation initiatives
reiterate the financial shortcomings of the local council
criticize earlier historical preservationists for negligence
introduce an entirely new species classification scheme
questions.explanation: Son paragraf okuyucuyu çevre koruma hareketine katılmaya davet eden bir eylem çağrısıdır.

title: GRE Verbal: Text Completion & Sentence Equivalence

questions.text: The senator's impassioned rhetoric was dismissed as mere ______, designed to inflame rather than inform.
questions.explanation: "demagoguery": demagoji, halkı galeyana getiren boş nutuk.

questions.text: Far from being ______, the author's philosophical prose is laden with esoteric jargon and labyrinthine syntax.
Her naturally ______ disposition made her well-suited for high-stakes diplomatic conciliation.
The curator sought to ______ the collection with rare manuscripts acquired from private estates.
The committee viewed the accountant's unexplained absences with deep ______.
The theoretical physicist was famous for dismantling accepted tenets with cheerful ______.
The government's refusal to compromise only served to ______ public resentment across the provinces.
His argument relied on an utterly ______ premise that collapsed under rudimentary scrutiny.
questions.explanation: "specious": ilk bakışta doğru görünen ama aldatıcı/asılsız.

title: GRE Verbal: Advanced Lexicon & Logic

questions.text: The critic's review was notoriously ______; no flaw escaped his biting, caustic pen.
questions.explanation: "vitriolic": zehir zemberek, son derece acımasız ve iğneleyici.

questions.text: The candidate tried to ______ his opponent's credibility through a series of unfounded smears.
The monastic community was renowned for its ______ lifestyle, shunning all modern luxuries.
The CEO gave an ______ response, refusing to commit either to job cuts or to wage increases.
The student tackled the dense philosophical treatise with surprising ______ and enthusiasm.
The treaty was intended to ______ the two warring border clans after decades of bloodshed.
Astronomers discovered that the strange optical flare was an ______ aberration caused by cosmic dust.
His outward display of wealth was an attempt to ______ his mounting private debts.

title: GRE Reading: Complex Argumentation & Passage Analysis

questions.text: The primary purpose of the passage is to ______.
options: re-evaluate the merits of a marginalized historiographical tradition
dismiss modern quantitative methods in favor of intuitive conjecture
celebrate the political accomplishments of a 19th-century diplomat
outline the biographical timeline of an influential playwright
questions.explanation: Metin göz ardı edilmiş bir tarihsel ekolün değerini yeniden tahlil etmektedir.

questions.text: The author implies which of the following concerning the prevailing economic orthodoxy?
options: It overlooks structural informal labour markets in its aggregate projections
It accurately predicts every macroeconomic recession with precision
It relies too heavily on archaic Marxist terminology
It was formulated exclusively by colonial trading companies
questions.explanation: Yazar yaygın ekonomik dogmanın kayıt dışı istihdamı hesaba katmadığını vurgular.

questions.text: In the context of the author's argument, the word 'untenable' most nearly means ______.
Which of the following, if true, would most severely weaken the author's primary thesis?
options: Newly unearthed archival records verify that grain yields rose throughout the drought
Contemporary accounts describe mild weather during the monarch's coronation
Peasants frequently migrated between feudal baronies in search of wages
Agricultural tax collections were managed by ecclesiastical bishops
questions.explanation: Kuraklık sırasında buğday hasadının arttığını gösteren delil, kıtlık hipotezini çürütür.

questions.text: The author mentions the fossilized pollen deposits primarily in order to ______.
options: corroborate paleoclimatic fluctuations described in oral narratives
illustrate the taxonomic diversity of Jurassic ferns
argue that ancient agrarian societies worshipped floral symbols
disprove that volcanic ash clouds affect solar radiation
questions.explanation: Polen kayıtları sözlü anlatılardaki iklim değişikliklerini doğrulamak amacıyla zikredilmiştir.

questions.text: The tone of the passage toward early biographers can best be characterized as ______.
questions.explanation: Yazar erken dönem biyografi yazarlarına karşı adil ve ölçülü bir eleştirel tutum takınmaktadır.

questions.text: It can be inferred from the passage that the transition to sedentary farming was ______.
options: prolonged and regionally idiosyncratic rather than uniform
abrupt and completed simultaneously across all continents
resisted by all prehistoric human settlements without exception
initiated exclusively by religious priestly castes in river deltas
questions.explanation: Metin tarıma geçişin tekdüze değil, bölgesel olarak farklılaşan uzun bir süreç olduğunu belirtir.

questions.text: According to the final paragraph, future historical inquiry must ______.
options: synthesize forensic geochemical analysis with literary archives
abandon archaeological digs due to excessive conservation costs
rely exclusively on AI-generated linguistic reconstructions
restrict investigative scope to royal court correspondence
questions.explanation: Sonuç bölümü jeokimyasal analizlerle edebi arşivlerin sentezlenmesi gerektiğini savunur.

title: PTE Academic: Reading & Writing Fill in the Blanks

questions.text: Urban green corridors provide a vital link ______ fragmented wildlife habitats in growing cities.
questions.explanation: İki veya belirli parçalar arasında köprü oluşturmada 'link between' kullanılır.

questions.text: The research team conducted extensive field experiments to ______ their initial theoretical model.
Deforestation in tropical basins has altered local hydrological patterns ______ unprecedented scale.
questions.explanation: "on an unprecedented scale": eşi benzeri görülmemiş bir ölçekte (sabit collocation).

questions.text: The newly discovered compound exhibits antibacterial properties that are ______ to those of penicillin.
Researchers must adhere strictly ______ established ethical protocols when conducting animal testing.
Global renewable investments have seen a ______ increase over the past five fiscal quarters.
The conference will bring together leading scholars to ______ the impact of artificial intelligence.
The manuscript was deemed too fragile to be put on display without a protective ______.

title: PTE Academic: Re-order Paragraphs & Cohesion

questions.text: Which sentence logically serves as the introductory topic sentence of an academic paragraph?
options: Throughout history, rivers have played a foundational role in shaping human civilizations.
These geographical advantages, however, were not without severe seasonal flood hazards.
Consequently, early Mesopotamian farmers constructed dykes to regulate river waters.
This hydrological innovation allowed urban settlements to flourish exponentially.
questions.explanation: Genel ve bağımsız bir giriş cümlesi ('Throughout history, rivers...') doğru başlangıçtır.

questions.text: Identify the logical referent connecting sentence 2 ('These findings...') to its predecessor.
options: A sentence reporting the specific metrics and experimental outcomes of the trial
A sentence discussing ancient Roman architectural aesthetics
A rhetorical question questioning the price of laboratory glassware
A concluding remark about the author's retirement plans
questions.explanation: 'These findings' ifadesi önceki cümlede sunulan deney sonuçlarına işaret eder.

questions.text: What is the primary role of the transition word 'Nonetheless' in academic argumentation?
options: To introduce a contrasting concession while maintaining the central thesis
To conclude an essay with a formal apology to critics
To list items in strict alphabetical order
To introduce a literal quotation from a dictionary
questions.explanation: 'Nonetheless' (yine de / buna rağmen) zıt bir kabulle ana fikri sürdürür.

questions.text: Choose the most cohesive concluding sentence for a text describing solar energy efficiency.
options: Continued advancements in perovskite photovoltaic cells promise to unlock even greater yields.
Coal mining was first commercialized during the British Industrial Revolution.
Many consumers prefer purchasing electric vehicles in blue or silver paint.
Wind turbines produce noise that disturbs local dairy cattle.
questions.explanation: Metnin konusunu (güneş enerjisi verimliliği) geleceğe dönük bağlayan tek cümledir.

questions.text: The pronoun 'This phenomenon' in paragraph three most logically refers to ______.
options: The rapid cooling of the upper stratosphere discussed in paragraph two
The price of petrol at suburban service stations
The architectural style of the United Nations headquarters
questions.explanation: Paragraf ikide tartışılan stratosferik soğuma olgusuna gönderme yapmaktadır.

questions.text: In academic writing, which signal word indicates a direct cause-and-effect relationship?
Select the correct ordering: [A] The satellite was launched. [B] Pre-flight checks were conducted. [C] Orbit was achieved.
questions.explanation: Kronolojik sıra: Uçuş öncesi kontroller -> Fırlatma -> Yörüngeye oturma.

questions.text: Which choice best illustrates anaphoric reference?
options: 'Dr. Alvarez published her treatise in 1980. She argued that an asteroid impacted Earth.'
questions.explanation: 'She' zamiri kendisinden önce geçen 'Dr. Alvarez'e anaphoric referans yapar.

title: PTE Academic: Summarize Written Text & Synthesis

questions.text: Which single compound-complex sentence best summarizes the passage on urban heat islands?
options: Although urbanization causes significant thermal absorption through asphalt and concrete, metropolitan areas can mitigate these heat islands by expanding canopy cover and reflective roofs.
Cities are hot because of cars and buildings.
Trees are very beautiful and everyone enjoys walking through green urban parks on warm summer days.
Air conditioning units consume electricity which raises utility bills for apartment dwellers.
questions.explanation: PTE 'Summarize Written Text' kriterlerine göre tek cümlede sebep, etki ve çözümü sentezler.

questions.text: What is the key grammatical constraint of PTE 'Summarize Written Text'?
options: The summary must be written in exactly ONE single complete sentence
The summary must be between five and eight separate bullet points
The summary must never exceed three words in total length
The summary must contain at least five exclamation marks
questions.explanation: PTE kuralı: Özet tam olarak tek bir bitmiş cümle olmalıdır.

questions.text: Which clause structure is most effective for compressing complex research conclusions?
options: A relative or participial subordinate clause linked with cohesive coordinators
A string of four short sentence fragments with semicolons
An informal conversational question directed at the grader
A quoted excerpt copied word for word from the first line
questions.explanation: Bileşik ve yan cümlecikli yapı akademik yoğunluğu ve dilbilgisini en iyi yansıtır.

questions.text: In summarizing, what should a test-taker strictly avoid?
options: Injecting personal opinions or outside facts not present in the original text
Using correct academic punctuation like commas and semicolons
Paraphrasing complex vocabulary with precise synonyms
Identifying the primary thesis and secondary supporting evidence
questions.explanation: Metinde olmayan dış bilgileri veya kişisel yorumları katmak puan kaybına yol açar.

questions.text: The passage discusses deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Which key idea must be included?
options: Chemosynthetic microorganisms sustain complex ecosystems independent of solar energy
Submarines are expensive to construct in modern shipyards
Scuba divers often encounter dolphins in shallow waters
Seawater contains approximately three percent sodium chloride
questions.explanation: Hidrotermal bacaların temel bilimsel önemi Güneş'e bağlı olmayan kemosentezdir.

questions.text: Select the correct connector to synthesize two complementary points: 'clean emissions' and 'low operating costs'.
questions.explanation: "not only... but also": sadece ... değil aynı zamanda ... (pekiştirici sentez).

questions.text: Identify the punctuation error in: 'The policy was enacted, however the opposition protested.'
options: A comma splice: 'however' needs a semicolon before it and comma after
The word 'enacted' should be spelled with a 'k'
There should be an exclamation mark after 'policy'
questions.explanation: İki bağımsız cümle 'however' ile bağlanırken noktalı virgül ve virgül gerekir (; however,).

questions.text: What is the ideal word count range for the single-sentence PTE summary?
questions.explanation: 35-45 kelime arası, tek cümlelik gramer doğruluğu ve anlam bütünlüğü için idealdir.

title: Duolingo English Test: Interactive Reading & Context

questions.text: Select the real English words from the list below:
questions.explanation: Sadece ilk seçenekteki kelimeler (Accomplish, Benevolent, Decisive) gerçek İngilizce sözcüklerdir.

questions.text: The new transit system is designed to be fully ______ for citizens with limited mobility.
Her dedication to public service has earned her the ______ of colleagues across the country.
Scientists were surprised by how quickly the seedlings managed to ______ to the dry soil.
The university library provides quiet study areas where students can ______ on their work.
Regular exercise and balanced nutrition are ______ components of a healthy lifestyle.
The documentary film aims to ______ the struggles faced by endangered polar wildlife.
She spoke with great ______ during the live television interview on youth education.

title: Duolingo English Test: Complete the Missing Words (C-Test)

questions.text: Complete the word: 'Photosynthesis is the process by which green pl____s convert sunlight into chemical energy.'
Complete the word: 'Scientists must col____t empirical data before drawing any firm conclusions.'
Complete the word: 'Linguistic research sh____s that learning a foreign language enhances memory.'
Complete the word: 'Renewable sources of en____y include wind, solar, and geothermal power.'
Complete the word: 'The museum has an ext____ve collection of ancient Egyptian pottery.'
Complete the word: 'Students are encouraged to part______te actively in seminar discussions.'
Complete the word: 'Urban planners are trying to red____e traffic congestion during rush hours.'
Complete the word: 'Regular physical activity is ben______al for both physical and mental health.'

title: Duolingo English Test: Writing Fluency & Topic Development

questions.text: Which thesis statement best addresses: 'Do the benefits of artificial intelligence outweigh its risks?'
options: While artificial intelligence poses legitimate challenges regarding data privacy and job automation, its transformative contributions to healthcare diagnosis and clean energy optimization demonstrate that its benefits outweigh its drawbacks.
AI is very cool and I like asking chat applications to write poetry for me.
Robots will probably conquer the universe and destroy everything.
There are many computers in modern schools across the world.
questions.explanation: İki tarafı da dengeli tartıp net bir tez ortaya koyan akademik yapıdır.

questions.text: What is the most effective way to start a 5-minute timed response on an unfamiliar topic?
options: State your direct position in the opening sentence and introduce two distinct reasons
Spend four minutes complaining about the difficulty of the prompt
Write random words to artificially inflate the word counter
Copy the prompt text repeatedly forty times
questions.explanation: Süre kısıtlı olduğundan ilk cümlede pozisyon belirtip 2 gerekçe sunmak en yüksek puanı getirir.

questions.text: Select the sentence with the highest lexical sophistication and natural fluency:
options: Technological immersion has fundamentally reshaped contemporary adolescent interpersonal communication.
Kids talk with phones a lot nowadays and it is different from old times.
Phone talking is much more than it was before for children.
People have devices which they use to speak with each other frequently.
questions.explanation: Zengin ve doğal akademik kelime dağarcığını ('immersion, fundamentally reshaped, interpersonal') yansıtır.

questions.text: In DET photo description prompts, which opening strategy yields the highest score?
options: Describe the focal subject, their actions, and contextual background using present continuous verbs
Just list three objects you see separated by commas
Write 'I do not know who took this photo'
Guess what the people in the picture will eat for dinner next week
questions.explanation: Fotoğraf tasvirinde ana özne, eylem ve arka plan present continuous ile betimlenmelidir.

questions.text: Which phrase smoothly introduces a counter-argument?
options: I think people are wrong because...
Maybe it is not true but...
questions.explanation: "Opponents frequently contend that": Karşı tezi akademik bir dille tanıtır.

questions.text: Select the correct connector to show cause: 'Due to severe weather, the flight was grounded.' What can replace 'Due to'?
Identify the grammatically flawless sentence:
options: Had she known about the seminar earlier, she would certainly have registered.
If she knew about the seminar earlier, she would have register.
Had she knew about the seminar earlier, she will register.
She had known about the seminar earlier, she would register.
questions.explanation: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi: 'Had she known..., she would have registered'.

questions.text: What is the primary evaluation metric for the DET writing section?
options: Grammatical accuracy, lexical diversity, task relevance, and fluency length
Typing speed alone regardless of spelling errors
Whether you agree with the computer grader's personal opinions
The number of commas you place per sentence
questions.explanation: DET dilbilgisi doğruluğu, sözcük çeşitliliği, konuya uygunluk ve akıcılık üzerinden puanlar.

title: EIKEN Grade Pre-1: High-Level Practical & Academic Lexicon

questions.text: The international committee voted to ______ emergency humanitarian assistance to the drought-hit area.
The ancient shrine was built on a ______ cliff overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
Citizens held a candlelight vigil to ______ the victims of the catastrophic earthquake.
The government refused to ______ with radical insurgents who held foreign hostages.
The new legislation is expected to ______ greater foreign investment in regional clean energy.
Despite hours of debate, the two political factions reached a complete ______.
The volcanic eruption caused ______ disruption to international flight corridors.
Senior officials are urged to lead by example and demonstrate absolute ______.

title: EIKEN Grade 1: Elite Vocabulary & Geopolitics

questions.text: The ambassador delivered a scathing ______ condemning territorial aggression.
questions.explanation: "diatribe": sert taşlama, yerin dibine batıran eleştirel nutuk.

questions.text: The court ruled that the contract was signed under extreme psychological ______.
The prime minister sought to ______ widespread public anger over rising inflation.
She displayed an ______ memory, recalling every treaty article verbatim.
The military junta ruled with an ______ fist, crushing all democratic opposition.
His philosophical arguments were marred by circular and ______ reasoning.
The company was accused of using tax havens to ______ its domestic fiscal obligations.
Scientists warn that the ecosystem has reached an irreversible ______ point.

title: EIKEN: Societal Issues & Reading Comprehension

questions.text: What is the primary argument against lowering the mandatory retirement age?
options: It deprives the economy of experienced talent and strains pension funds
It encourages younger workers to emigrate abroad immediately
It causes public transportation systems to operate at a deficit
It prevents university graduates from securing entry-level jobs
questions.explanation: Metinde emeklilik yaşını düşürmenin tecrübeli iş gücünü kaybettirdiği ve emekli sandıklarına yük getirdiği belirtilmiştir.

questions.text: How can municipal governments encourage sustainable recycling among households?
options: By implementing convenient sorted collection points and educational programs
By doubling the price of fresh vegetables at local markets
By prohibiting all plastic manufacturing completely within seven days
By requiring citizens to burn household trash in private yards
questions.explanation: Belediyelerin eğitim ve kolay erişilebilir ayrıştırma merkezleri kurması sürdürülebilirliği sağlar.

questions.text: The author suggests that globalization has contributed to ______ in regional manufacturing.
options: increased competition and off-shoring of low-skilled assembly jobs
the total elimination of international cargo shipping lines
a return to pre-industrial handicraft workshops across cities
a universal standard price for all consumer electronics
questions.explanation: Küreselleşme düşük vasıflı işlerin yurt dışına kaymasına yol açmıştır.

questions.text: In passage 2, the term 'demographic headwinds' refers to ______.
options: an aging population accompanied by a declining fertility rate
unexpected storms along maritime shipping routes
unfavorable consumer preferences in the automobile industry
foreign exchange fluctuations impacting import duties
questions.explanation: 'Demographic headwinds': Nüfus yaşlanması ve doğurganlığın düşmesi sorunu.

questions.text: Which measure is recommended to alleviate overcrowding on commuter rail lines?
options: Promoting flexible telecommuting and staggered work hours
Abolishing all passenger train services during peak morning hours
Doubling fares exclusively for university students
Replacing trains with fleets of motorized pedal bicycles
questions.explanation: Esnek çalışma saatleri ve evden çalışma raylı sistem yoğunluğunu hafifletir.

questions.text: Why do some agriculturalists express reservations regarding genetically modified crops?
options: Potential long-term impacts on local biodiversity and farmer patent reliance
They produce fruit that is too large to fit in shopping carts
They require three hundred percent more land area to cultivate
They attract wild bears into suburban shopping plazas
questions.explanation: Biyoçeşitlilik üzerindeki olası etkiler ve tohum patenti bağımlılığı çekincelerin başında gelir.

questions.text: According to the concluding paragraph, renewable energy adoption requires ______.
options: upgrades to electrical storage grids and consistent state support
the immediate demolition of all existing hydroelectric dams
converting personal automobiles to run on steam engines
restricting electricity consumption to daylight hours only
questions.explanation: Yenilenebilir enerji şebeke depolama altyapısı ve devlet teşviki gerektirir.

questions.text: What tone does the essayist maintain regarding the future of international space exploration?
options: Completely pessimistic and dismissive of all science
Aggressively jingoistic and hostile to other nations
Humorous and satirical throughout every section
questions.explanation: Yazar uluslararası ortaklıklar konusunda temkinli bir iyimserlik içindedir.

title: YDS / YÖKDİL: Academic Cloze Test & Connectors

questions.text: The government launched an ambitious campaign to ______ the spread of infectious waterborne diseases.
Extensive reforestation initiatives helped ______ the risk of disastrous spring mudslides.
______ the harsh macroeconomic headwinds, the automotive enterprise recorded unprecedented export revenues.
questions.explanation: "In spite of": -e rağmen (zıtlık bildiren zarf edatı).

questions.text: The new environmental directive stipulates that factories must ______ carbon emissions by 40% by 2030.
Agricultural yields began to decline precipitously, ______ leading to severe domestic food shortages.
Medical researchers are struggling to find an effective vaccine ______ the virus mutates so rapidly.
The economic council advised that investments should be allocated ______ emerging technology startups.
Had the rescue team not arrived in time, the trapped miners ______ from lack of oxygen.
questions.explanation: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi temel cümlesi: 'would have perished'.

title: YDS / YÖKDİL: Sentence Completion & Logical Flow

questions.text: Although substantial subsidies have been directed toward electric vehicle manufacturing, ______.
options: consumer adoption rates remain constrained by the scarcity of fast-charging stations
electric vehicles produce zero tailpipe carbon emissions during driving
many automobile producers have completely stopped manufacturing diesel engines
battery technologies have improved exponentially over the past five years
questions.explanation: 'Although' zıtlık bildirir: Teşviklere rağmen tüketici adaptasyonu şarj istasyonu eksikliği yüzünden kısıtlı kalmıştır.

questions.text: ______ that many deep-sea organisms produce biological luminescence to attract prey.
options: Because the ocean floor is pitch black
In order to explore volcanic hydrothermal vents
Unless submarine sensor arrays function properly
questions.explanation: 'That' noun clause'ını ana cümle olarak tamamlayan 'Marine biologists have long verified'dır.

questions.text: Unless stringent anti-poaching measures are enforced immediately, ______.
options: the northern white rhinoceros will inevitably face total extinction in the wild
wildlife rangers have arrested several armed smugglers near the reserve
safari tourism has generated millions of dollars for local rural schools
natural ecosystems have evolved over millions of uninterrupted epochs
questions.explanation: 'Unless' (olmadıkça/eğer ... -mezse) olumsuz bir geleceğe bağlar: nesil tükenmesi kaçınılmaz olacaktır.

questions.text: So pronounced was the economic disparity between the two regions ______.
options: that central authorities were forced to enact special development grants
because both provinces shared the same linguistic dialect
although industrial production rose in every agricultural sector
in order to promote bilateral diplomatic harmony across the border
questions.explanation: Devrik 'So + sıfat + was... that...' sonuç kalıbıdır.

questions.text: Owing to the unprecedented drought that scorched the Mesopotamian plains, ______.
options: agrarian city-states suffered catastrophic crop failures and civil unrest
farmers exported surplus grain to neighboring Mediterranean markets
river dykes overflowed and destroyed nearby irrigation networks
agricultural yields reached record high levels throughout the millennium
questions.explanation: 'Owing to' sebep bildirir: Şiddetli kuraklık sebebiyle ekin kıtlığı ve iç huzursuzluk yaşanmıştır.

questions.text: No sooner had the peace accord been signed in Geneva ______.
options: than fresh border clashes erupted in the disputed border valley
when delegates celebrated with an international banquet
that both nations agreed to demilitarize the frontier zone
before the United Nations passed an emergency resolution
questions.explanation: "No sooner had... than..." (yapar yapmaz / henüz olmuştu ki) sabit korelatif kalıptır.

questions.text: ______ in that it allows geneticists to edit specific nucleotide sequences with unprecedented accuracy.
options: CRISPR technology differs fundamentally from earlier genetic engineering tools
Many pharmaceutical companies invest billions of dollars in viral testing
Because cellular enzymes break down foreign nucleic acids rapidly
Although ethical debates continue to surround human embryo research
questions.explanation: 'in that' (-mesi bakımından) önceki cümlenin özelliğini açıklar.

questions.text: Just as the invention of the printing press democratized written literacy in Europe, ______.
options: so too has the internet transformed global access to academic knowledge
because parchment paper was expensive to manufacture in monasteries
although medieval scribes hand-copied manuscripts for royal patrons
therefore public libraries charged membership fees for book loans
questions.explanation: "Just as... so too..." (Tıpkı ... gibi, aynı şekilde ... de) benzetme kalıbıdır.

title: YDS / YÖKDİL: Academic Reading Comprehension & Restatement

questions.text: Which option provides the closest restatement: 'Had the government not intervened with emergency subsidies, the regional steel industry would certainly have collapsed.'
options: The regional steel industry was saved from collapse solely due to the government's emergency subsidies.
Even with government emergency subsidies, the regional steel industry was unable to avoid complete bankruptcy.
The government intervened with subsidies after the regional steel industry had already collapsed.
The regional steel industry collapsed despite the substantial emergency funding provided by the state.
questions.explanation: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesinin en doğru anlamca eşiti: Hükümet sübvansiyonları sayesinde çöküşten kurtulmuştur.

questions.text: Which option provides the closest restatement: 'It is impossible to overstate the importance of cardiovascular conditioning in the prevention of chronic disease.'
options: Cardiovascular conditioning is profoundly essential for preventing chronic illness.
Cardiovascular conditioning is somewhat helpful, but its benefits are often exaggerated.
Chronic diseases can never be prevented regardless of how much cardiovascular training one does.
The importance of cardiovascular training is minimal compared to pharmacological therapies.
questions.explanation: 'It is impossible to overstate the importance': Ne kadar vurgulansa azdır / hayati derecede önemlidir.

questions.text: In academic reading, what does the transition 'By the same token' signify?
options: Similarly, and for the same reason
At an unspecified point in the historical past
questions.explanation: "By the same token": Aynı şekilde / aynı gerekçeyle ('similarly' eşanlamlısı).

questions.text: The passage states that the Renaissance was not a sudden rupture with medieval times, but rather ______.
options: a gradual culmination of cultural and intellectual currents that began centuries earlier
a violent military conquest that destroyed all earlier literary traditions
a brief financial speculative bubble centered exclusively in Venice
an artificial myth created by twentieth-century romantic novelists
questions.explanation: Metin Rönesans'ın ani bir kopuş değil, kademeli bir kültürel birikim ve doruk noktası olduğunu ifade eder.

questions.text: According to the author, the primary obstacle to deep-space manned voyages is ______.
options: prolonged exposure to cosmic radiation and microgravity physiological deterioration
the complete absence of titanium ore on the lunar surface
a lack of public interest in watching broadcast rocket launches
the inability of rocket engines to operate in sub-zero atmospheric temperatures
questions.explanation: Metne göre ana engeller kozmik radyasyon ve yerçekimsiz ortamdaki fizyolojik bozulmadır.

questions.text: What can be inferred regarding the decipherment of the Rosetta Stone?
options: It required comparing identical decree texts across three distinct writing systems
It was accomplished in a single afternoon by a solitary French explorer
It proved that ancient hieroglyphs were purely decorative and carried no phonetic values
It confirmed that Greek was never spoken in ancient Alexandria
questions.explanation: Rosetta Taşı üç farklı yazı sistemiyle yazılmış aynı metnin karşılaştırılmasıyla çözülmüştür.

questions.text: The author's primary objective in writing this article is to ______.
options: dispel popular misconceptions regarding the causes of the Bronze Age Collapse
encourage tourists to visit newly excavated ruins in the eastern Mediterranean
accuse contemporary archaeologists of falsifying carbon-14 dating results
solicit private financial donations for a new university museum wing
questions.explanation: Yazar Tunç Çağı çöküşü hakkındaki yaygın popüler yanlış inanışları çürütmeyi amaçlamaktadır.

questions.text: Which title best captures the core essence of the entire passage?
options: The Complex Interplay of Ecological Stress and Geopolitical Shifts in Ancient Societies
How to Build an Ancient Seagoing Trireme from Lebanese Cedar
The Daily Life and Culinary Habits of Bronze Age Potters
Why Modern Earthquakes Are Less Dangerous Than Ancient Tremors
questions.explanation: Metnin ana fikrini kapsayan en kapsamlı ve akademik başlık ilk seçenektir.
